clips.title: The story
paras: This errand directs novice gnome warlocks out of Ironforge to seek advanced instruction in human lands. With King Magni Bronzebeard keeping a vigilant watch on dark practitioners within the dwarven mountain, mentors must rely on Stormwind's hidden networks to complete their disciples' training.

Before the fall of Gnomeregan, aspiring warlocks in Khaz Modan studied under their own tinker-mages and demonic scholars deep within the techno-city. The disaster that drove the gnomes into exile scattered those institutions. The surviving practitioners found themselves cramped into Ironforge's gloomy, subterranean caverns, operating under the distrustful eye of King Magni Bronzebeard and the dwarven guard. Unable to practice demonic arts openly or cultivate dangerous rituals in such tight quarters, senior instructors like Lago Blackwrench have little choice but to send their students away.

The destination for these expatriate students is the Slaughtered Lamb, an unassuming tavern nestled in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. Beneath its taproom, concealed behind twisting stone passages and descending stairs, lies a subterranean sanctum where human warlocks gather in shadows. Overseen by seasoned summoners like Gakin the Darkbinder, the cove provides the space and dark paraphernalia required to teach novices how to summon and bind minor demons without drawing the immediate wrath of city marshals.

While Stormwind's coven welcomes capable hands, the influx of refugee novices creates friction. Human mentors already walk a knife's edge to avoid detection from the city's paladins and authorities. Gakin and his colleagues find their clandestine sanctuary increasingly crowded by practitioners sent south from Khaz Modan. The steady stream of dwarven-mountain traffic risks blowing the lid on their discreet operation, yet neither side possesses an easier alternative.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hmph. Times past, all warlocks in Khaz Modan were trained under the auspices of the masters of Gnomeregan, but now that we've all been forced to relocate into this rat's hole in Ironforge, and Magni's decided to keep a careful watch on us, we're forced to send our novices to Stormwind for training.
Luckily, Gakin's no slouch, so you'll still learn what you need to know, but it burns my blood!
Anyways, you'll find Gakin in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Sent by Blackwrench, were you? Damn warlocks in Ironforge need to get things sorted out. There's only so much room and so many teachers in Stormwind. With all the increased traffic, we're sure to attract attention sooner or later.
